research_topic: Why does time seem to flow in only one direction?
scientific_reframing: Can a resolution-aware cross-scale inference program distinguish physical entropy production from preparation, hidden-variable, coarse-graining, and record-formation asymmetries while representing the cosmological low-gravitational-entropy problem as an explicit boundary condition?
primary_conclusion: The proposal treats the thermodynamic arrow as an operational, model- and resolution-dependent attribution problem. It can test finite-system dissipation and artifacts, but it does not claim to measure or derive the universe's low-gravitational-entropy initial condition.
remaining_human_reviews: Stochastic thermodynamics, quantum-open-systems, and cosmology review before implementation
